body:
Offline deployment bundle for OpenViking 0.4.17.1 + full dependency set.

Asset: ov-wheels-0.4.17.1-win-amd64.zip (163 wheels / ~164 MB; Windows x86_64; Python 3.10+ incl. 3.12)

Usage on an air-gapped host:
  1) unzip the archive (yields an ov-wheels/ folder)
  2) pip install --no-index --find-links ov-wheels/ openviking
  3) openviking-server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 1933

Generated via: pip download --only-binary=:all: openviking (2026-09-04).
Verified: clean-venv offline install succeeded (163 packages, no network).
Helper scripts + docs: repo offline/ folder.
name: v0.1.0 - OpenViking 0.4.17.1 offline wheel bundle
